features.name: Magellanic Stream
features.noun: Neutral hydrogen gas stream (not visible to the eye)
features.description: A stream of neutral hydrogen gas pulled out of the Magellanic Clouds, seen only in 21-cm radio emission. The line is a guide along the Stream equator of the Magellanic Stream coordinate system; the distances along it are assumptions, not measurements.

facts.label: Length of the Stream plus Leading Arm (at least)
Neutral hydrogen mass (Putman et al. 2003, at 55 kpc)
Coordinate system
facts.value: Magellanic Stream coordinates: equator is the great circle with pole at (l, b) = (188.5, -7.5) deg; L_MS = 0 at the LMC centre

features.name: Magellanic Bridge
features.noun: Neutral hydrogen gas bridge (not visible to the eye)
features.description: Neutral hydrogen gas between the Large and the Small Magellanic Cloud. The line is a guide from one Cloud centre to the other; the real gas is spread over a wide area.

facts.label: Angular separation of the two Cloud centres

features.name: Leading Arm
features.noun: Neutral hydrogen gas stream (not visible to the eye)
features.description: Neutral hydrogen gas that leads the Magellanic Clouds along their orbit. The line is a guide through the centres of the two main complexes, LA I and LA II; the distance is an assumption.

facts.label: Extent of complex LA I (Magellanic longitude, latitude)
Extent of complex LA II (Magellanic longitude, latitude)
